sentences.en: This episode of 100 Objects is brought to you by Anthropic, the team behind Claude.
sentences.zh: 本期《100件物品》由Claude背后的团队Anthropic为您呈现。

sentences.en: Claude is the AI for minds that don't stop at good enough.
sentences.zh: Claude是为那些追求卓越、永不止步的头脑而生的AI。

sentences.en: It's the collaborator that actually understands your entire workflow and thinks with you.
sentences.zh: 它是一位真正理解你整个工作流程并与你共同思考的合作伙伴。

sentences.en: Whether you're debugging code at midnight or strategizing your next business move,
sentences.zh: 无论你是深夜调试代码，还是在规划下一步的商业战略，

sentences.en: Claude extends your thinking to tackle the problems that matter.
sentences.zh: Claude都能拓展你的思维，助你解决关键问题。

sentences.en: Build interactive tools and apps by describing what you need.
sentences.zh: 只需描述你的需求，即可构建交互式工具和应用程序。

sentences.en: Custom calculators, data visualization dashboards, even prototypes,
sentences.zh: 自定义计算器、数据可视化仪表板，甚至是原型设计，

sentences.en: all without writing a single line of code.
sentences.zh: 全程无需编写一行代码。

sentences.en: For problems worth solving, get started with Claude at Claude.ai.
sentences.zh: 若想解决棘手难题，请访问Claude.ai开始使用Claude。

sentences.en: After decades of political tensions, the Cold War is finally beginning to thaw out.
sentences.zh: 经过几十年的政治紧张局势，冷战终于开始解冻。

sentences.en: But despite this, we start our story underground, in a windowless room.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我们的故事却始于地下，一个没有窗户的房间里。

sentences.en: It was literally called the bomb shelter.
sentences.zh: 它真的就被称为“防空洞”。
这位是特里·埃尔德里奇。

sentences.en: It was a basement space, just this wide open room.
sentences.zh: 那是一个地下室空间，就是一个宽敞的空房间。

sentences.en: On this particular winter afternoon, Terry found himself hunkered down in the bomb shelter.
sentences.zh: 在那个冬日的午后，特里发现自己正蜷缩在防空洞里。

sentences.en: But he wasn't taking cover from an incoming missile or nuclear fallout.
sentences.zh: 但他并不是在躲避导弹或核辐射。

sentences.en: The bomb shelter was just a rec room in a dorm where Terry went to college.
sentences.zh: 这个防空洞只是特里上大学时宿舍里的一个娱乐室。

sentences.en: He and some classmates had gathered there because Terry had recently received a phone call from his dad,
sentences.zh: 他和几位同学聚在那里，因为特里刚接到他父亲罗伊的电话，

sentences.en: Roy, and he told Terry to make sure he was going to be near a TV in just a few days' time.
sentences.zh: 罗伊告诉特里，过几天一定要确保自己在电视机旁。

sentences.en: Because something really good was going to be on.
sentences.zh: 因为会有非常精彩的节目播出。

sentences.en: Over $76,000 just waiting to be won today on Wheel of Fortune.
sentences.zh: 今天在《幸运轮》节目中，有超过76,000美元的奖金等着被赢走。
现在，有请我们的主持人。

sentences.en: Me and a bunch of friends sat and watched my dad on Wheel of Fortune, and it was really surreal.
sentences.zh: 我和一群朋友坐在一起看我父亲上《幸运轮》，那种感觉真的很超现实。

sentences.en: Did it surprise you to learn that he was going to be on TV?
sentences.zh: 得知他要上电视，你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: Was this out of character for him?
He had been a Denver cop for years.
sentences.zh: 他当了多年的丹佛警察。
来自科罗拉多州布鲁姆菲尔德的罗伊·埃尔德里奇。

sentences.en: What do you do back there?
I'm chief of physical security for a large government facility.
sentences.zh: 我是一家大型政府机构的物理安全主管。

sentences.en: It turns out Terry's dad was good at the game.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，特里的父亲很擅长这个游戏。

sentences.en: Roy was the biggest earner of the day and qualified to play the bonus round for a pretty sweet prize.
sentences.zh: 罗伊是当天赢钱最多的人，并获得了参加奖金轮比赛的资格，去争夺一份相当丰厚的奖品。

sentences.en: Roy, you're going to be playing for the Jeep Wrangler open-air model with room for four.
sentences.zh: 罗伊，你将要争夺的是这款四座敞篷吉普牧马人。

sentences.en: He won this beautiful red Jeep Wrangler.
sentences.zh: 他赢得了这辆漂亮的红色吉普牧马人。

sentences.en: Fifteen seconds to talk it out.
And I'm thinking, you got this 19 or 20-year-old kid in college?
sentences.zh: 当时我在想，你一个19、20岁的大学生，

sentences.en: You don't need a Jeep Wrangler, but I would love one.
sentences.zh: 你不需要吉普牧马人，但我可是很想要一辆。

sentences.en: And I was so excited thinking, I am getting a Jeep.
sentences.zh: 我当时兴奋极了，心想，我要有一辆吉普车了。
特里最终没能得到那辆吉普车。

sentences.en: At the time, Wheel of Fortune had a segment called The Shopping Round.
sentences.zh: 当时，《幸运轮》有一个环节叫“购物轮”。

sentences.en: You got there by spinning the wheel, of course, solving the puzzle, and hopefully winning thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 当然，你得通过转动轮盘、解开谜题，并希望能赢取数千美元才能进入这个环节。

sentences.en: But you didn't get to take any of that cash home.
sentences.zh: 但你并不能把那些现金带回家。

sentences.en: Instead, contestants had to spend it all right there during the shopping round,
sentences.zh: 相反，参赛者必须在购物环节当场把钱花光，

sentences.en: where they forced you to buy random things that filled the stage.
sentences.zh: 他们会强迫你购买摆满舞台的各种随机商品。

sentences.en: Jet skis, vacation packages, you got whatever you could afford.
sentences.zh: 摩托艇、度假套餐，你能买得起什么就买什么。

sentences.en: And every episode, the announcer would hype up those very prizes that you'd been forced to buy.
sentences.zh: 每一集，主持人都会大肆宣传那些你被迫购买的奖品。

sentences.en: My dad bought these horrible gold-plated sunglasses.
sentences.zh: 我父亲买了一副极其难看的镀金太阳镜。

sentences.en: The Cazale 951 Sports System sunglasses in an attractive presentation kit.
sentences.zh: Cazale 951运动系列太阳镜，配有精美的展示盒。

sentences.en: That looked like something straight out of the Elvis wardrobe.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是从猫王衣橱里直接拿出来的一样。

sentences.en: And he also bought what at the time was a very pretty crystal peacock.
sentences.zh: 他还买了一只当时看起来很漂亮的水晶孔雀。

sentences.en: Crystal large peacock, handcrafted at the finest, 32% lead Austrian crystal, $800.
sentences.zh: 大型水晶孔雀，顶级手工制作，32%铅含量的奥地利水晶，800美元。

sentences.en: Towards the end of the round, once people got down to less than $200, there wasn't much left to buy.
sentences.zh: 在环节快结束时，当人们剩下的钱不到200美元时，就没剩下什么可买的了。

sentences.en: Except for, for about $150, there was always this ceramic dog.
sentences.zh: 除了，大约150美元左右，总会有这只陶瓷狗。

sentences.en: Top honors go to our favorite mascot, Wheel of Fortune's ceramic Dalmatian, a medium-sized dog we've all learned to love.
sentences.zh: 最高荣誉归于我们最爱的吉祥物——《幸运轮》的陶瓷大麦町犬，一只我们都已学会去爱的小型犬。

sentences.en: A life-sized, black-and-white polka dot dog, made out of baked clay.
sentences.zh: 一只真人大小、带有波点图案的黑白陶瓷狗。

sentences.en: It was kind of a consolation prize.
Here's what you get with whatever money you have left that isn't enough to buy anything else on the set, except for this dog.
sentences.zh: 如果你剩下的钱不够买现场任何其他东西，除了这只狗，这就是你得到的。

sentences.en: It was truly just the thing you got when you couldn't afford anything else.
sentences.zh: 它真的就是当你买不起其他任何东西时，你才会得到的东西。

sentences.en: Terry doesn't even really remember seeing his dad buy one.
sentences.zh: 特里甚至不记得他父亲买过这东西。

sentences.en: And like so many people who went on Wheel of Fortune in the 1980s, a ceramic Dalmatian ended up back at Roy's house.
sentences.zh: 就像20世纪80年代参加《幸运轮》的许多人一样，这只陶瓷大麦町犬最终回到了罗伊的家里。

sentences.en: After the excitement of watching his dad on Wheel of Fortune, Terry finished college, moved, bought a home, got married, and started a family of his own.
sentences.zh: 在看完父亲上《幸运轮》的兴奋之后，特里大学毕业、搬家、买房、结婚，并组建了自己的家庭。

sentences.en: His father kept the dog all that time.
sentences.zh: 他父亲一直留着那只狗。

sentences.en: And then, one day, he pulled Terry aside.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，他把特里叫到一边。

sentences.en: And he said, hey, take the dog home with you.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，把这只狗带回家吧。

sentences.en: So he has sat in our house, guarding the top of the stairs for the past 20-plus years.
sentences.zh: 所以，在过去的20多年里，它一直坐在我们家楼梯顶端守着。

sentences.en: Thanks to his dad, Terry is the proud owner of perhaps the ultimate useless object.
sentences.zh: 多亏了他父亲，特里成了这件终极无用之物的骄傲拥有者。

sentences.en: The Wheel of Fortune ceramic Dalmatian has no discernible purpose whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 《幸运轮》的陶瓷大麦町犬没有任何可辨识的用途。

sentences.en: Functionally, nothing would change in Terry's life if he got rid of it.
sentences.zh: 从功能上讲，如果特里把它扔了，他的生活不会有任何改变。

sentences.en: But he insists he never, ever will.
sentences.zh: 但他坚持说他永远、永远不会扔掉它。

sentences.en: And it's not just beloved to Terry.
sentences.zh: 而且它不仅是特里的心头好。

sentences.en: For a brief moment, it became the mascot for one of America's most popular game shows,
sentences.zh: 在短暂的一段时间里，它成为了美国最受欢迎的游戏节目之一的吉祥物，

sentences.en: appearing on tens of millions of TV screens, night after night, all across the country.
sentences.zh: 每晚出现在全国数千万台电视屏幕上。

sentences.en: If you watched Wheel of Fortune in the 1980s, I bet you big money you remember the ceramic Dalmatian.
sentences.zh: 如果你在20世纪80年代看过《幸运轮》，我敢打赌你一定记得那只陶瓷大麦町犬。

sentences.en: But why did this fake, useless dog capture the fleeting attention of our nation?
sentences.zh: 但为什么这只虚假、无用的狗会吸引我们国家短暂的注意力呢？

sentences.en: From 99% Invisible and BBC Studios, this is a history of the United States in 100 Objects.
sentences.zh: 来自《99%隐形》和BBC工作室，这是《100件物品中的美国史》。

sentences.en: And today, why the Wheel of Fortune ceramic Dalmatian is the perfect symbol of the game show,
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将探讨为什么《幸运轮》的陶瓷大麦町犬是该节目的完美象征，

sentences.en: and what the fascinating history of game shows and game show prizes tells us about the changing definition of the American dream.
sentences.zh: 以及游戏节目及其奖品的迷人历史如何揭示了美国梦定义的变迁。

sentences.en: One of the things that fascinates me about game shows is the prizes.
sentences.zh: 游戏节目中最让我着迷的一点就是奖品。

sentences.en: I've probably seen thousands of hours of game shows in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子可能看过数千小时的游戏节目。

sentences.en: Growing up, I remember skipping school to watch Wheel of Fortune or The Price is Right.
sentences.zh: 成长过程中，我记得曾逃课去看《幸运轮》或《价格猜猜猜》。

sentences.en: But I wasn't just into solving puzzles or guessing the price of a bottle of dish soap.
sentences.zh: 但我不仅仅是对解谜或猜测一瓶洗洁精的价格感兴趣。

sentences.en: Like millions of other Americans watching along with me, I wanted to see the stuff people won.
sentences.zh: 就像数百万和我一起观看的美国人一样，我想看看人们赢得了什么东西。

sentences.en: Prizes are central to a game show.
sentences.zh: 奖品是游戏节目的核心。

sentences.en: They are the reason viewers keep tuning in, imagining we could be the ones driving home in that brand new car.
sentences.zh: 它们是观众持续收看的原因，让我们幻想自己也能开着那辆崭新的汽车回家。

sentences.en: And those prizes have been there since the very start, before they were even called game shows.
sentences.zh: 而且这些奖品从一开始就存在，甚至在它们被称为“游戏节目”之前就有了。

sentences.en: As far as we know, the quiz show is an American invention.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，问答节目是一项美国发明。

sentences.en: It appears that the first one on the air was a show on the radio around 1924 called Brooklyn Daily Eagle Quiz on Current Events.
sentences.zh: 看来第一个播出的节目是1924年左右电台的一档节目，叫《布鲁克林每日鹰报时事问答》。

sentences.en: This is Adam Nedeff, author, historian, and researcher for the National Archives of Game Show History.
sentences.zh: 这位是亚当·内德夫，作家、历史学家，也是国家游戏节目历史档案馆的研究员。

sentences.en: The Brooklyn Daily Eagle was a newspaper in New York, and they had these events called Current Events Bees.
sentences.zh: 《布鲁克林每日鹰报》是纽约的一份报纸，他们举办过一种叫“时事竞赛”的活动。

sentences.en: These events were kind of like a spelling bee for topical issues.
sentences.zh: 这些活动有点像针对时事话题的拼字比赛。

sentences.en: Give a correct answer, you stayed in the conteSt.
sentences.zh: 回答正确，你就能留在比赛中。

sentences.en: And the final person standing won both bragging rights and a small cash prize.
sentences.zh: 最后胜出的人既赢得了吹嘘的资本，也获得了一小笔现金奖励。

sentences.en: And whenever Brooklyn Daily Eagle ran a Current Events Bee, they would run a special edition of the paper
sentences.zh: 每当《布鲁克林每日鹰报》举办时事竞赛时，他们都会发行一份特别版的报纸，

sentences.en: where they printed all of the questions and all of the correct answers and always sold a lot of extra copies.
sentences.zh: 上面印着所有的问题和正确答案，总是能多卖出很多份。

sentences.en: So Brooklyn Daily Eagle had the idea that, hey, we can sell copies of the paper with these things.
sentences.zh: 所以《布鲁克林每日鹰报》想到，嘿，我们可以通过这些东西来卖报纸。

sentences.en: Let's start putting the Current Events Bee on radio.
sentences.zh: 让我们开始把时事竞赛搬上电台吧。

sentences.en: So that was the idea originally.
The first game show was invented to sell newspapers.
sentences.zh: 第一个游戏节目是为了卖报纸而发明的。

sentences.en: Around the same time, another radio show emerged called Vox Pop.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时间，另一档电台节目出现了，叫《大众之声》。

sentences.en: It started out with hosts asking random people on the street their opinions on things happening in the news.
sentences.zh: 它最初的形式是主持人询问街上的路人对新闻事件的看法。

sentences.en: Did you read the paper today?
Well, I got about halfway through it.
I'm going to see how well you did about it.
sentences.zh: 我要看看你对它了解多少。

sentences.en: And eventually they came upon the idea, let's do a segment of the show where we see what people actually know about these subjects.
sentences.zh: 最终他们想到了一个主意，在节目中增加一个环节，看看人们对这些话题到底了解多少。

sentences.en: We'll ask them questions about what's going on in the news.
sentences.zh: 我们会问他们关于新闻中正在发生的事情的问题。

sentences.en: I want you to give me three prominent items that were featured in the newspapers this week.
sentences.zh: 我要你列举出本周报纸上报道的三条重要新闻。

sentences.en: And people didn't want to participate in this segment because they didn't want to risk looking foolish on the radio.
sentences.zh: 人们不想参加这个环节，因为他们不想冒着在电台上出丑的风险。

sentences.en: So the hosts had this idea, well, let's take a wad of money with us.
sentences.zh: 于是主持人想了个主意，带上一大把钱。

sentences.en: And we'll give people a dollar if they give the correct answer.
sentences.zh: 如果人们回答正确，我们就给他们一美元。

sentences.en: All right, here's one for each correct answer.
sentences.zh: 好吧，每答对一题就给一美元。

sentences.en: A single dollar for a correct answer was all the incentive many needed.
sentences.zh: 对于许多人来说，答对一题就能获得一美元，这足以成为动力。

sentences.en: After all, this was the middle of the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，当时正处于大萧条时期。

sentences.en: Quiz shows quickly became a potent form of distraction.
sentences.zh: 问答节目很快成为了一种强有力的消遣方式。

sentences.en: Swaths of listeners who couldn't afford other entertainment could fantasize about winning a dollar for knowing a fact or two.
sentences.zh: 大批负担不起其他娱乐活动的听众，可以幻想通过了解一两件事实来赢取一美元。

sentences.en: These first quiz shows were also the perfect snapshot of a quintessentially American idea.
sentences.zh: 这些早期的问答节目也是典型的美国式理念的完美缩影。

sentences.en: If you applied yourself and you were smart, you could really achieve something, like winning a cash prize.
sentences.zh: 如果你努力并且聪明，你真的可以实现一些目标，比如赢得现金奖励。

sentences.en: These shows were always modest affairs.
sentences.zh: 这些节目一直都是小规模的。

sentences.en: During World War II, the feds actually asked a lot of the shows to shut down for fear that an audience member would leak war secrets live on the air.
sentences.zh: 二战期间，联邦政府实际上要求许多节目停播，担心观众会在直播中泄露战争机密。

sentences.en: But a few quiz shows stuck around, like one called Information Please, where the prizes included a $25 defense bond, practical and patriotic.
sentences.zh: 但仍有一些问答节目坚持了下来，比如《请回答》，其中的奖品包括25美元的国防债券，既实用又爱国。

sentences.en: Quiz shows had never been about big giveaways anyways.
sentences.zh: 问答节目从来都不是为了发放巨额奖品而存在的。

sentences.en: The idea of, boy, wouldn't it be great to win on a quiz show?
sentences.zh: 那种“天哪，如果能在问答节目中获胜该多好？”的想法，

sentences.en: That would solve all my probleMs.
No, that never happened until the end of World War II, when all of a sudden they turned on the money faucet.
sentences.zh: 不，这种情况直到二战结束才出现，当时他们突然打开了金钱的水龙头。

sentences.en: That money faucet would change quiz shows forever.
sentences.zh: 那个金钱的水龙头将永远改变问答节目。

sentences.en: And it started thanks to the post-war boom in manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都要归功于战后制造业的繁荣。

sentences.en: Word needed to get out that goods were being produced again.
sentences.zh: 当时急需让大家知道商品又开始生产了。

sentences.en: And so that led to big giveaways on radio because giving away your furniture or your appliances from your factory was a good way to let Americans know,
sentences.zh: 于是，这促成了电台的大规模赠礼活动，因为把工厂生产的家具或家电送出去，是让美国人了解情况的好办法，

sentences.en: hey, we're up and running full speed again.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我们已经全面恢复生产，全速运转了。

sentences.en: We have so many things coming out of our factory that we can just give away a refrigerator on this radio show.
sentences.zh: 我们的工厂产量巨大，以至于可以在电台节目里直接送出一台冰箱。

sentences.en: So, you know, go out and buy a refrigerator this weekend at the department store.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这个周末去百货商店买台冰箱吧。

sentences.en: Not only could more people now afford consumer goods, they wanted them.
sentences.zh: 不仅更多人买得起消费品，而且他们也渴望拥有这些东西。

sentences.en: Keeping up with the Joneses really became a big deal at the end of World War II.
sentences.zh: 二战结束后，“攀比心理”确实成了一件大事。

sentences.en: There was this dream that you were being sold of, it's not just about being able to provide for your family.
sentences.zh: 当时人们被灌输着这样一个梦想：生活不仅仅是为了养家糊口。

sentences.en: It's about having nice stuff for your family.
sentences.zh: 而是要为家人提供优渥的物质条件。

sentences.en: And quiz shows had evolved to a point where they suddenly fit into that American dream.
sentences.zh: 而智力竞赛节目也发展到了一个阶段，突然间与那个“美国梦”契合了。

sentences.en: At the same time that Americans are trying to acquire stuff, that's when the quiz shows all of a sudden are giving stuff away in massive quantities.
sentences.zh: 就在美国人努力获取物质的同时，智力竞赛节目也开始大规模地赠送奖品。

sentences.en: So these radio shows evolved in the same direction that the country at large was evolving.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些电台节目的演变方向与整个国家的发展方向是一致的。

sentences.en: Quiz shows became a kind of mirror of American society.
sentences.zh: 智力竞赛节目成了美国社会的一面镜子。

sentences.en: As consumer culture took off, quiz shows became more and more popular.
sentences.zh: 随着消费文化的兴起，智力竞赛节目变得越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: What had started 30 years before as a way to sell some newspapers was exploding into a full-blown American phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 这项始于30年前、最初只是为了推销报纸的活动，正演变成一种彻头彻尾的美国现象。

sentences.en: TV played a huge role in this, turning the radio quiz show into a visual spectacle with dramatic studio lighting, on-screen countdowns, and glitzy sets.
sentences.zh: 电视在其中发挥了巨大作用，它将电台智力竞赛变成了视觉盛宴，配有戏剧性的演播室灯光、屏幕倒计时和华丽的布景。

sentences.en: But it wasn't just the over-the-top production that made these quiz shows so successful.
sentences.zh: 但让这些节目大获成功的不仅仅是夸张的制作。

sentences.en: Many of them continued to push that core American value that you can have all the stuff you want.
sentences.zh: 许多节目继续推崇那个核心的美国价值观：你可以拥有你想要的一切。

sentences.en: You can get that American dream by working hard and using your own wits.
sentences.zh: 只要努力工作并运用智慧，你就能实现那个美国梦。

sentences.en: A new program called itself the show where, quote,
sentences.zh: 有一个新节目自称是这样一个节目，引用其话来说：

sentences.en: Knowledge is king and the reward is king-sized.
sentences.zh: “知识为王，奖赏也是王者级别。”

sentences.en: You see, as everything else got bigger, more shows, wider audiences, bigger sponsors, the prizes they were offering grew too.
sentences.zh: 你看，随着一切规模的扩大——更多的节目、更广的受众、更大的赞助商——它们提供的奖金也随之水涨船高。

sentences.en: And those king-sized rewards, they were literally a thousand times bigger than what had come before.
sentences.zh: 而那些王者级别的奖赏，实际上比以前的奖金高出了一千倍。

sentences.en: As Take It or Leave It, presented by the makers of Eversharp Skyline pens...
sentences.zh: 正如由Eversharp Skyline钢笔制造商赞助的《拿走还是留下》（Take It or Leave It）节目……

sentences.en: The explosion of massive cash prizes began in the 1950s,
sentences.zh: 巨额现金奖金的爆发始于20世纪50年代，

sentences.en: when a producer named Lewis Cohen decided to reimagine a hit radio quiz show called Take It or Leave It.
sentences.zh: 当时一位名叫刘易斯·科恩（Lewis Cohen）的制片人决定重新构思一档热门电台智力竞赛节目《拿走还是留下》。

sentences.en: The most exciting game you ever played.
sentences.zh: 这是你玩过的最刺激的游戏。

sentences.en: The game that doubles in interest with every question asked.
sentences.zh: 一个随着问题提出而趣味倍增的游戏。

sentences.en: At the heart of Take It or Leave It was the $64 question.
sentences.zh: 《拿走还是留下》的核心是64美元的问题。

sentences.en: An opportunity for contestants to gamble the $32 they had already won for $64.
sentences.zh: 让参赛者有机会用已经赢得的32美元去博取64美元。

sentences.en: If they could successfully answer the hardest category of question on the show.
sentences.zh: 前提是他们能成功回答节目中最难的一类问题。

sentences.en: Would you like to take your 32?
But in his version, which would be made for TV,
sentences.zh: 但在他为电视制作的版本中，

sentences.en: Lewis Cohen wanted to raise the stakes.
sentences.zh: 刘易斯·科恩想要提高赌注。

sentences.en: And so he pitched a new show called The $64,000 Question.
sentences.zh: 于是他推出了一个名为《64,000美元问题》（The $64,000 Question）的新节目。

sentences.en: The $64,000 Question is the monster hit of television in 1955.
sentences.zh: 《64,000美元问题》是1955年电视界的超级热门节目。

sentences.en: And of course, imitation is the sincerest form of television.
sentences.zh: 当然，模仿是电视界最真诚的致敬方式。

sentences.en: So the shows that are already on the air start introducing big money elements.
sentences.zh: 所以，已经在播出的节目也开始引入大额奖金元素。

sentences.en: And tonight's super bonus on Beat the Clock.
sentences.zh: 这是今晚《打败时钟》（Beat the Clock）的超级奖金。

sentences.en: Beat the Clock introduces the super bonus stunt,
sentences.zh: 《打败时钟》引入了超级奖金特技，

sentences.en: which is worth $64,000 or even more.
And now Freezone presents Name That Tune.
sentences.zh: 现在由Freezone呈现《猜曲名》（Name That Tune）。

sentences.en: The grand prize on Name That Tune had been $1,600.
And all of a sudden, they're offering $25,000.
sentences.zh: 而突然之间，他们开始提供25,000美元的奖金。

sentences.en: Suddenly, quiz shows were offering way more money than they ever had.
sentences.zh: 一时间，智力竞赛节目提供的奖金远超以往。

sentences.en: But the people who were actually paying for these massive prizes
sentences.zh: 但是，那些真正支付这些巨额奖金的人，

sentences.en: still wanted a return on their investment.
sentences.zh: 仍然希望获得投资回报。

sentences.en: In fact, they expected bigger returns than ever.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们期望的回报比以往任何时候都高。

sentences.en: And to guarantee big returns, these shows looked to replicate
sentences.zh: 为了保证高回报，这些节目试图复制
其他地方已经行之有效的方法。

sentences.en: The $64,000 Question is a big hit show, and it has an isolation booth.
sentences.zh: 《64,000美元问题》是一档大热节目，它设有隔离间。

sentences.en: So, producers Jack Barry and Dan Unright have this idea,
sentences.zh: 于是，制片人杰克·巴里（Jack Barry）和丹·恩莱特（Dan Enright）有了个想法，

sentences.en: let's do a quiz show with two isolation booths.
sentences.zh: 我们来做一个有两个隔离间的智力竞赛节目吧。

sentences.en: Two contestants answered trivia questions in isolation booths.
sentences.zh: 两名参赛者在隔离间里回答常识问题。

sentences.en: Neither of them knew how the other one was doing.
sentences.zh: 他们谁都不知道对方表现如何。

sentences.en: Questions were worth up to 11 points each.
Whoever got the closest to 21 without going over, won.
sentences.zh: 谁最接近21点且不超过，谁就获胜。

sentences.en: It's basically blackjack mixed with your standard-issue general knowledge quiz.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是把21点纸牌游戏和普通的常识问答结合在了一起。

sentences.en: The thunderous reception from our studio weddings indicates that both of you are well-liked
sentences.zh: 演播室观众热烈的掌声表明你们两位都很受欢迎，

sentences.en: and having a hard job deciding who they want to win or lose on this program.
sentences.zh: 他们很难决定在这个节目中希望谁赢谁输。

sentences.en: As 21 became more successful, the producers wanted to do more with the show
sentences.zh: 随着《21点》越来越成功，制片人想做的不仅仅是

sentences.en: than just build dazzling sets and give away insane cash prizes.
sentences.zh: 搭建炫目的布景和送出疯狂的现金大奖。

sentences.en: They wanted to push the boundaries of what defined a quiz show
sentences.zh: 他们想通过提升节目中出现的普通美国人的形象，

sentences.en: by elevating the average Americans that you'd see on these programs
sentences.zh: 让参赛者变得非同凡响，从而突破智力竞赛节目的定义。

sentences.en: and making the contestants larger than life.
sentences.zh: 丹·恩莱特挑选参赛者的方式很特别。

sentences.en: Dan Unright kind of cast his contestants.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是现在游戏节目挑选参赛者那种意义上的挑选，

sentences.en: Not cast them just in the sense that game shows cast contestants now,
sentences.zh: 即“哦，这些人性格迷人，观众想在电视上看到他们”。

sentences.en: which is, oh, these people have engaging personalities that you want to see on television.
sentences.zh: 不，丹·恩莱特实际上是把参赛者当作角色来挑选。

sentences.en: No, Dan Unright would actually cast contestants as in they were characters to him.
sentences.zh: 恩莱特挑选《21点》的参赛者就像在选电影演员一样。

sentences.en: Unright was casting 21 as if it was a movie.
sentences.zh: 而每一部好电影都需要一位明星。

sentences.en: And every good movie needs a star.
sentences.zh: 10分题，说出亨利八世的第二、三、四、五任妻子的名字，

sentences.en: For 10 points, name the second, third, fourth, and fifth wives of Henry VIII

sentences.zh: 制片人在一位名叫查尔斯·范多伦（Charles Van Doren）的参赛者身上找到了这位明星。

sentences.en: The producers found that star in a contestant named Charles Van Doren.

sentences.zh: 你要我列出第二、三、四、五任妻子的名字，

sentences.en: You want me to name the second, third, fourth, fifth wives,
sentences.zh: 还要说出她们所有人的结局？

sentences.en: and what happened to all of them?
I'll have to think a minute, Dan.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·范多伦来自一个非常著名的家庭。

sentences.en: Charles Van Doren was from a very famous family.
sentences.zh: 他的亲戚都是作家、诗人、评论家和教授。

sentences.en: His relatives were authors and poets and critics and professors.
sentences.zh: 范多伦本人也是一位教授，长相非常英俊，

sentences.en: And Van Doren himself is a professor, very good-looking guy,
sentences.zh: 极具魅力，非常引人入胜，非常讨人喜欢。

sentences.en: incredibly charismatic, incredibly engaging, incredibly likable.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，查理，我收到很多关于你的提问。

sentences.en: Charlie, incidentally, I've had a lot of questions about you.
Well, whether or not you're married or single.

sentences.zh: 除了魅力和英俊的外表，范多伦还很聪明。

sentences.en: And along with all that charisma and those good looks, Van Doren was intelligent, too.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他聪明到创下了持续14周的连胜纪录。

sentences.en: So intelligent, in fact, that he went on a winning streak that lasted 14 weeks.
sentences.zh: 我们目前的获胜者查尔斯·范多伦，到目前为止已经赢得了46,500美元。

sentences.en: Our current winner, Charles Van Doren, has so far won $46,500.
sentences.zh: 再过一会儿，范多伦先生的总奖金有望达到88,500美元。

sentences.en: In just a moment, Mr. Van Doren can conceivably bring his total winnings up to $88,500.
sentences.zh: 范多伦的连胜让他从一名常春藤盟校的英语讲师一跃成为全国性的电视名人。

sentences.en: Van Doren's winning streak catapulted him from an Ivy League English lecturer to national TV celebrity.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·范多伦登上了《时代》周刊的封面。

sentences.en: Charles Van Doren makes the cover of Time magazine.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·范多伦登上了《电视指南》的封面。

sentences.en: Charles Van Doren makes the cover of TV Guide.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·范多伦以一种智力竞赛选手通常不会有的方式成为了明星。

sentences.en: Charles Van Doren becomes a star in a way that quiz show contestants don't normally become stars.
It was like a fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 这位迷人、英俊、聪明的学者从默默无闻中被发掘，变身为全国超级巨星。

sentences.en: The charming, handsome, intelligent academic plucked out of obscurity and transformed into a national superstar.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这童话色彩浓得有点过头了。

sentences.en: In fact, it was a little too much like a fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 这个节目完全是作弊的。
查尔斯·范多伦并没有连续赢下14周，至少不是正当赢得的。

sentences.en: Charles Van Doren didn't win 14 straight weeks in a row, at least not legitimately.
sentences.zh: 《21点》的制片人在他上节目之前就已经内定他为冠军了。

sentences.en: The producers of 21 had hand-selected him as their champion before he even went on the air.
sentences.zh: 他们提前把所有答案都告诉了范多伦以及其他所有内定的获胜者。

sentences.en: They told Van Doren and all the other previous hand-picked winners all of the answers ahead of time.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是《21点》和范多伦的问题。

sentences.en: And this wasn't just 21 and Van Doren.
sentences.zh: 50年代末几乎所有的大额奖金智力竞赛节目，虽然不是全部，但绝大多数都是作弊的。

sentences.en: Pretty much all of the big money quizzes in the late 50s, not all of them, but the vast majority of them were fixed.
sentences.zh: 但在某个阶段，为了维持戏剧性并让观众保持兴趣，即使是内定的获胜者最终也必须输掉比赛。

sentences.en: But at some point, to keep the drama going and viewers hooked wanting more, even hand-picked winners had to eventually lose.
sentences.zh: 而《21点》的制片人也在决定这一点。

sentences.en: And the producers of 21 were deciding that too.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅告诉他要输掉比赛，还规定了怎么输、在哪个问题上输。

sentences.en: Not only did they tell him to throw the match, but how and on which question.
sentences.zh: 但范多伦太成功了，以至于NBC不想让他离开。

sentences.en: But Van Doren had been such a success that NBC didn't want to let him go.
sentences.zh: 当他注定要输掉比赛离开《21点》时，NBC决定为他找另一份工作，让他留在电视台。

sentences.en: When he was set to lose and leave 21, NBC decided to find him another gig that would keep him on the network.
sentences.zh: 他们让他担任了《今日秀》（Today Show）的所谓文化通讯员。

sentences.en: They made him what they called the cultural correspondent for the Today Show.
sentences.zh: 但并不是每个人都对此感到高兴。

sentences.en: But not everybody was happy about this.
sentences.zh: 之前的参赛者看着查尔斯·范多伦平稳着陆，心想：

sentences.en: Previous contestants were looking at Charles Van Doren's soft landing and thinking,
sentences.zh: 等等，我同意输掉比赛后，我的电视工作在哪里？

sentences.en: Hang on, where was my television gig after I agreed to lose?

sentences.zh: 你可以把他们从街上拉过来，然后说：

sentences.en: And you can pull them off the street and say,
sentences.zh: “你不能告诉任何人我们在做什么。”

sentences.en: You can't tell anybody what we're doing.
You've got to keep this a secret.

sentences.zh: 但现实中，他们肯定会告诉自己的配偶。

sentences.en: But realistically, they're going to tell their spouse.
sentences.zh: 他们肯定会告诉最好的朋友。

sentences.en: They're going to tell their best friend.
sentences.zh: 你每操纵一个参赛者，就会有五个人发现幕后发生了什么。

sentences.en: For every one contestant that you rig, five people are going to find out what's happening behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 当你拥有这么多以这种方式运作的节目时，真相大白只是时间问题。

sentences.en: And when you have this many shows that are operating this way, it's only a matter of time before the word gets out.
And word did eventually get out.
sentences.zh: 1958年8月，热门智力竞赛节目《Dotto》在毫无预兆的情况下被停播。

sentences.en: In August of 1958, the successful quiz show Dotto was unceremoniously yanked off the air.
And for days, nobody knew why.
sentences.zh: 然后媒体得到了一条消息。

sentences.en: And then the press got word of a story.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，一名本应参加节目的男子在后台发现了另一位参赛者的笔记本。

sentences.en: A few months earlier, a man who was due to appear on the show found another contestant's notebook backstage.
sentences.zh: 里面写满了当晚节目的所有答案。

sentences.en: It was filled with all the answers for that evening's show.
sentences.zh: 那些她本不可能提前知道的问题的答案。

sentences.en: Answers to questions she couldn't have known yet.
sentences.zh: 发现笔记本的参赛者将其泄露给了报社。

sentences.en: The contestant who found the notebook leaked it to the papers.

sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，操纵游戏节目并不违法。

sentences.en: Technically, rigging a game show wasn't illegal.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，当时并没有法律规定不能这样做。

sentences.en: As in, there weren't really any laws that said you couldn't.
sentences.zh: 但这一技术性漏洞并没有阻止丑闻引发公众的分裂。

sentences.en: But that technicality didn't stop the scandal from dividing the public.
sentences.zh: 随着智力竞赛节目正在接受调查的消息传出，许多人感到愤怒，觉得自己受到了欺骗。

sentences.en: As the news that quiz shows were being investigated got out, many were upset and felt they had been deceived.
sentences.zh: 对作弊智力竞赛节目的反应之大，促使联邦立法者开始介入调查。

sentences.en: The reaction to rigged quiz shows was so great that federal lawmakers started to investigate.
sentences.zh: 在参议院听证室里，针对作弊和操纵智力竞赛节目的调查达到了戏剧性的高潮。

sentences.en: In the Senate hearing room, the dramatic climax of the probe of fixed and rigged quiz shows.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，想到国会竟然会介入智力竞赛节目，真是太令人惊讶了。

sentences.en: I mean, it is pretty amazing to think of Congress getting involved in quiz shows.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于国会为何要介入智力竞赛丑闻，有一个愤世嫉俗的答案，基本上是因为1958年是改选年。

sentences.en: You know, there's a cynical answer in why Congress wanted to be involved with the quiz show scandals, which basically 1958 was a re-election year.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于那些面临改选的国会议员来说，能有东西去监管是一个很好的表现机会。

sentences.en: So the idea of having something to police was a good look for the congressmen who were up for re-election.
sentences.zh: 而查尔斯·范多伦正是那些国会听证会的焦点人物。

sentences.en: And Charles Van Doren was at the center of those congressional hearings.
sentences.zh: 而查尔斯·范多伦正是那些国会听证会的焦点人物。

sentences.en: Charles Van Doren arrives to apologize and attempt to explain to the millions whose friendship and respect he had won.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·范多伦赶来道歉，并试图向数百万曾给予他友谊与尊重的人解释这一切。

sentences.en: What really tipped the scales was a letter that I got from a woman who'd seen me on today.
sentences.zh: 真正让我下定决心的是我收到的一封信，写信的女士在《今日》节目中看到了我。

sentences.en: And in it, she said, you must, in order to live with yourself, tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 她在信中说，为了问心无愧，你必须说出真相。

sentences.en: That's the only way a man can live with the truth.
sentences.zh: 这是一个人能坦然面对真相的唯一方式。

sentences.en: As a result of the congressional hearings, Van Doren was fired from NBC and forced to leave his job at Columbia University.
sentences.zh: 国会听证会结束后，范多伦被 NBC 解雇，并被迫辞去了哥伦比亚大学的教职。

sentences.en: He had gone from celebrity to the face of a scandal he would never escape.
sentences.zh: 他从一位名人变成了一场他永远无法逃脱的丑闻的代名词。

sentences.en: As for the TV programs themselves, after dazzling us with the drama of impossible questions, charismatic contestants, incredible feats of human intelligence, and giant cash prizes,
sentences.zh: 至于电视节目本身，在用那些不可思议的问题、魅力十足的选手、令人惊叹的智力表现和巨额奖金让我们眼花缭乱之后，

sentences.en: the era of the great American quiz show was over.
sentences.zh: 美国大型益智竞赛节目的时代结束了。

sentences.en: All these shows, $64,000 question, 21, Dotto, all of these rigged quiz shows are off the air by the autumn of 1958.
sentences.zh: 所有这些节目，比如《64,000美元问题》、《21点》、《多托》，这些被操纵的益智节目在1958年秋天全部停播了。

sentences.en: Because, okay, now we have our proof that these quiz shows rigged.
sentences.zh: 因为，好吧，现在我们有了这些益智节目作弊的证据。

sentences.en: Maybe the worst part of all this was the scandals left many of us kind of brokenhearted.
sentences.zh: 也许最糟糕的是，这些丑闻让许多人感到心碎。

sentences.en: I think it does say something about quiz shows that people were this upset.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们如此难过，本身就说明了益智节目在人们心中的地位。

sentences.en: The American public was hurt to learn that this stuff wasn't real.
sentences.zh: 美国公众得知这些东西竟然是假的，感到受到了伤害。

sentences.en: A lot of that hurt came from the fact that the story quiz show fans had been sold,
